summary: Send Zotero-API-Key only to zotero.org origins; warn and omit the header for any other host.
reason: Greptile P1 (security) on publish PR #1668: a hostile ZOTERO_RESEARCH_LIBRARY_BASE_URL received the configured API key on every request. Generator retro candidate: generated clients should scope credential headers to the spec's canonical origins by default.
validated_outcome: Requests to non-zotero.org hosts carry no Zotero-API-Key and emit a stderr warning; live zotero.org calls unchanged; build/tests pass.
